page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a distinct contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and text processing, alongside a poor bottom 10% rating in single-threaded gzip compression. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently achieve average tier results. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, as well as Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations, also align with average performance tiers.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge offers high resource density with 56 dedicated cores, making it suitable for parallelized workloads that can offset the lower single-core efficiency of its older Intel Xeon architecture. The instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations that benefit from a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio without requiring local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
